content: Mobile nav convention (verified Material archive + m3 intent): bottom navigation serves 3-5 top-level destinations; beyond five, tap targets crowd and overflow must go to an alternative location (drawer/sheet). Bar height 56dp, icons must navigate (not open menus) with the overflow exception, labels never truncate, active item tinted with primary color, tapping active item returns to top of view. Apple HIG analog: tab bar with system More fallback treated as a fallback not a design goal; badges convey dynamic status. BombVault 4-tab bottom bar + More sheet (10 destinations) fits the convention exactly.
